data.content_ref: inline:§11.3 flags are sustained because the adjudication-ritual applies a mechanistic requirement (school-0 stance: demand a causal mechanism) to the critics, but the critics under test (frontier-claim-honest@v1, frontier-above-floor@v1) operate on a non-mechanistic epistemic register — the former evaluates honesty, the latter evaluates threshold-crossing. Neither critic is architecturally capable of producing a causal mechanism explanation because their designs are evaluative, not explanatory. The flag fires as a true positive: the ritual correctly identifies that the critics cannot meet the mechanist bar. The fix is either to exempt non-mechanistic critics from the mechanist stance or to require all admitted critics to include a causal-mechanism module.
